Encumbered.Tooltip: Why did you try to carry this much?! Require help when attempting to move at more than a snail's pace or take any nontrivial action.

UTCF.CrewTypeBox: Click to choose a Crew Type
UTCF.ChooseOneOrTwoEdges: Choose one or two edges and an equal number of flaws
UTCF.AddAdditionalTypeOfGangText:
You can add an additional type to a gang or expert by spending two crew upgrades.
When a cohort performs actions for which its types apply, it uses its full quality rating. Otherwise, its quality is zero. A given cohort can have up to two types. Some crew upgrades will add the “Elite” feature to a gang, which gives them +1d when they roll for a given Type.
UTCF.ClassExpClue1: Every time you roll a desperate action, mark xp in that action's attribute.
UTCF.ClassExpClue2: You expressed your beliefs, drives, heritage, or background.
UTCF.ClassExpClue3: You struggled with issues from your vice or traumas during the session.
UTCF.ClassExpClueDescription: At the end of each session, for each item below, mark 1 xp (in your playbook or an attribute) or 2 xp if that item occurred multiple times.
UTCF.CrewExpClue1: At the end of each session, for each item below, mark 1 xp (or instead mark 2xp if that item occurred multiple times).
UTCF.GangTypeRoversDescription: Sailors, carriage drivers, and deathlands scavengers.
UTCF.EdgesFearsomeDescription: The cohort is terrifying in aspect and reputation.
UTCF.EdgesIndependentDescription: The cohort can be trusted to make good decisions and act on their own initiative in the absence of direct orders.
UTCF.EdgesLoyalDescription: The cohort can't be bribed or turned against you.
UTCF.EdgesTenaciousDescription: The cohort won't be deterred from a task.
UTCF.FlawsPrincipledDescription: The cohort has an ethic or values that it won't betray.
UTCF.FlawsSavageDescription: The cohort is excessively violent and cruel.
UTCF.FlawsUnreliableDescription: The cohort isn't always available, due to other obligations, stupefaction from their vices, etc.
UTCF.FlawsWildDescription: The cohort is drunken, debauched, and loud-mouthed.
UTCF.HarmImpairedDescription: The cohort operates with reduced quality (-1d).
UTCF.HarmBrokenDescription: The cohort can't do anything until they recover.
UTCF.HarmDeadDescription: The cohort is destroyed. You can spend coin equal to your Tier +2 to restore it, plus two downtime activities to recruit new gang members, or hire a new expert.
UTCF.RollTokenDescription: If you want to pull the numbers from a character, select their Token first.
UTCF.RollPartialSuccessPositionControlled: You hesitate. Withdraw and try a different approach, or else do it with a minor consequence: a minor complication occurs, you have reduced effect, you suffer lesser harm, you end up in a risky position.
UTCF.RollPartialSuccessPositionRisky: You do it, but there's a consequence: you suffer harm, a complication occurs, you have reduced effect, you end up in a desperate position.
UTCF.RollPartialSuccessPosition: You do it, but there's a consequence: you suffer severe harm, a serious complication occurs, you have reduced effect.
UTCF.RollFailurePositionControlled: You falter. Press on by seizing a risky opportunity, or withdraw and try a different approach.
UTCF.RollFailurePositionRisky: Things go badly. You suffer harm, a complication occurs, you end up in a desperate position, you lose this opportunity.
UTCF.RollFailurePositionDesperate: It's the worst outcome. You suffer severe harm, a serious complication occurs, you lose this opportunity for action.
UTCF.RollResistance:
You reduce or avoid the effects of the consequence (GM chooses).
Suffer {stress} stress.
UTCF.RollResistanceCritical:
You reduce or avoid the effects of the consequence (GM chooses).
Clear 1 stress.

Result.Fail: You hesitate; you may try again from a risky position or may try a different approach.
Result.PartialSuccess: You succeed with a minor consequence or may try a different approach.

Result.Fail: Your endeavor fails; you must suffer a standard consequence or lose this opportunity.
Result.PartialSuccess: You succeed at a cost: you suffer a standard consequence.

Result.Fail: Your endeavor comes to ruin; you suffer a serious consequence and lose this opportunity.
Result.PartialSuccess: You succeed, but a price must be paid: you suffer a serious consequence.

Result.Crit: You succeed with style and increased effect.

UTCF.Name: Name
UTCF.AcquireAssetExtra: To raise the result beyond critical, you may spend 2 coin per +1 Tier bonus.
UTCF.RollViceFailure: You overindulge. Clear {clear_stress} stress and choose one of the following consequences:
UTCF.RollViceFailureAttactTrouble: Attract Trouble. Select or roll an additional entanglement.
UTCF.RollViceFailureLost: Lost. Your character vanishes for a few weeks. Play a different character until this one returns from their bender. When your character returns, they've also healed any harm they had.
UTCF.RollViceFailureTapped: Tapped. Your current purveyor cuts you off. Find a new source for your vice.
UTCF.RollFortuneCritical: The result is exceptional. You have great or extreme effect.
UTCF.RollFortuneSuccess: The result is good. You have standard or full effect.
UTCF.RollFortunePartialSuccess: The result is mixed. You have limited or partial effect.
UTCF.RollFortuneFailure: The result is bad. You have poor or little effect.
UTCF.RollGatherInformationSuccess: Great: You get exceptional details. The information is complete and follow-up questions may expand into related areas or reveal more than you hoped for.
UTCF.RollGatherInformationPartialSuccess: Standard: You get good details. Clarifying and follow-up questions are possible.
UTCF.RollGatherInformationFailure: Limited: You get incomplete or partial information. More information gathering will be needed to get all the answers.
UTCF.RollEngagementCritical: Exceptional result. You've already overcome the first obstacle and you're in a controlled position for what's next.
UTCF.RollEngagementSuccess: Good result. You're in a controlled position when the action starts.
UTCF.RollEngagementPartialSuccess: Mixed result. You're in a risky position when the action starts.
UTCF.RollEngagementFailure: Bad result. You're in a desperate position when the action starts.
UTCF.RollAcquireAssetResult: You gain an asset of Tier {tier_quality} quality.
